snippet.title: Guardians Planetfall - Official Trailer | UploadVR Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist Guardians Planetfall: https://virtualage.io/planetfall
Join the community: https://discord.gg/FP4nJx3tEP

This trailer was revealed during the UploadVR Summer Showcase 2026. Guardians Planetfall is a co-op tactical VR shooter from the creators of Guardians Frontline.

Deploy into a galaxy-wide war for the fate of humanity. Fight solo or in squads of up to 4 players across hostile procedural planets and space installations, facing swarming alien Bugs, Void soldiers, drones, walkers, and massive war machines.

Drop onto hostile worlds and fight across jungles, frozen tundras, volcanic plains, alien deserts, and derelict space stations. Every biome features unique hazards, day-night cycles, partial destruction and procedural layouts that make each mission unpredictable.

Customize your loadout and grow stronger with advanced weapons, specialized suits, and powerful ship-deployed stratagems. Gather resources, craft consumables, and upgrade your gear with rare blueprints.

Command and upgrade your spaceship as your mobile base and ultimate weapon. Research new systems, repair damage, and call down devastating fire support during missions.

Influence a living Galactic War where community actions shift planetary control. Liberate worlds, repel invasions, sabotage Void facilities, and help shape the fate of the entire galaxy.

Build your own missions with a powerful co-op editor that lets you sculpt terrain, place enemies, set objectives, and create full facilities or open-world maps. Publish your creations and see the best missions added directly into the Galactic War for everyone to play.

🛰️ Early Access coming in 2026
🌌 Wishlist now and prepare to join the Galactic War
